Tom — thanks, received the W-9 and corp docs. To move this to Finance and get a vendor ID created we typically need the following from your side:

- Legal entity name (exact, as on tax docs)
- Billing address and remit-to address (if different)
- Federal Tax ID / EIN (matching W-9)
- Preferred invoice email and PO acceptance contact
- Payment method: ACH (preferred) or Wire; if ACH, we need routing + account and a bank letter or voided check
- Currency and payment terms (e.g., Net 30)
- Bank details for international wires (SWIFT/BIC) if applicable
- Any requested vendor classification (1099 contractor vs vendor entity)

Im attaching our buyer intake form (link below) — please fill and return. Once we have the bank verification + W-9 verified by Finance, production activation typically takes 3 business days. If you need a faster turnaround, flag it here and we can try to prioritize.

Intake form: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1OliveOnboard
